Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: feldspar Any of a set of the most common minerals in the _____'s crust
Glossary of geology.fact: feldspar Any of a set of the most common minerals in the Earth's crust.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: felsic _____ minerals, magmas, and rocks which are enriched in the lighter elements such as silicon, oxygen, aluminium, sodium, and potassium
Glossary of geology.fact: felsic Silicate minerals, magmas, and rocks which are enriched in the lighter elements such as silicon, oxygen, aluminium, sodium, and potassium.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Light minerals (quartz and feldspar) greater than _____ - acid
Glossary of geology.fact: Light minerals (quartz and feldspar) greater than 60% - acid.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: [Granite (_____), Adamellite (Rhyo-dacite), Granodiorite (Dacite)]
Glossary of geology.fact: [Granite (Rhyolite), Adamellite (Rhyo-dacite), Granodiorite (Dacite)].

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: fossiliferous _____ or being composed of fossils in rocks or strata
Glossary of geology.fact: fossiliferous Bearing or being composed of fossils in rocks or strata.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: fumarole A vent in the _____'s surface from which hot gases and vapors are emitted
Glossary of geology.fact: fumarole A vent in the Earth's surface from which hot gases and vapors are emitted.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: When not otherwise qualified, it usually indicates 1,000,000,000 years _____ (or 1,000,000,000 years ago)
Glossary of geology.fact: When not otherwise qualified, it usually indicates 1,000,000,000 years Before Present (or 1,000,000,000 years ago).

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: geogenic Of geologic origin – _____ from naturally occurring geological processes
Glossary of geology.fact: geogenic Of geologic origin – Resulting from naturally occurring geological processes.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: glass _____ (non-crystalline) hard and brittle solid such as soda-lime glass
Glossary of geology.fact: glass Amorphous (non-crystalline) hard and brittle solid such as soda-lime glass.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Gondwanaland The southern part of the supercontinent of _____ which eventually separated to form present-day South America, Africa, India, Australia and Antarctica
Glossary of geology.fact: Gondwanaland The southern part of the supercontinent of Pangaea which eventually separated to form present-day South America, Africa, India, Australia and Antarctica.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: graben A depressed block of the _____'s crust bordered by parallel faults
Glossary of geology.fact: graben A depressed block of the Earth's crust bordered by parallel faults.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: granite A coarse-grained, often porphyritic, intrusive, felsic, igneous rock containing megascopic quartz, averaging _____, much feldspar (orthoclase, microcline, sodic plagioclase) and mica or other
Glossary of geology.fact: granite A coarse-grained, often porphyritic, intrusive, felsic, igneous rock containing megascopic quartz, averaging 25%, much feldspar (orthoclase, microcline, sodic plagioclase) and mica or other coloured minerals.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: granulometry _____ distribution of the size of individual sediment grains, or lithified particles in clastic rocks
Glossary of geology.fact: granulometry Statistical distribution of the size of individual sediment grains, or lithified particles in clastic rocks.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: grus _____ eroded, angular grains of quartz and feldspar derived from a granitoid
Glossary of geology.fact: grus Freshly eroded, angular grains of quartz and feldspar derived from a granitoid.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: hardpan hemicrystalline _____ the properties of certain rocks of igneous origin which contain some interstitial glass in addition to crystalline minerals
Glossary of geology.fact: hardpan hemicrystalline Having the properties of certain rocks of igneous origin which contain some interstitial glass in addition to crystalline minerals.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: holocrystalline _____ the properties of those igneous rocks in which all of the components are crystalline; glass is absent
Glossary of geology.fact: holocrystalline Having the properties of those igneous rocks in which all of the components are crystalline; glass is absent.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: hot spring A natural spring resulting from the emergence of geothermally heated groundwater from beneath the _____'s crust
Glossary of geology.fact: hot spring A natural spring resulting from the emergence of geothermally heated groundwater from beneath the Earth's crust.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: hydrothermal _____ to the actions or products of heated water
Glossary of geology.fact: hydrothermal Pertaining to the actions or products of heated water.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: hypersaline _____ a saltiness or dissolved salt content greater than that of seawater
Glossary of geology.fact: hypersaline Having a saltiness or dissolved salt content greater than that of seawater.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: idiomorphic _____ by the crystal faces peculiar to the species, used of minerals
Glossary of geology.fact: idiomorphic Bounded by the crystal faces peculiar to the species, used of minerals.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: ignimbrite _____-grained to aphanitic, buff to dark brown compact rock with parallel streaks or lenticles of black glass, produced by violently explosive volcanoes
Glossary of geology.fact: ignimbrite Fine-grained to aphanitic, buff to dark brown compact rock with parallel streaks or lenticles of black glass, produced by violently explosive volcanoes.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The name "illite" is inherited from the state of _____ where natural non-swelling clay deposits exist
Glossary of geology.fact: The name "illite" is inherited from the state of Illinois where natural non-swelling clay deposits exist.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: intrusionbody of igneous rock that has crystallized from molten magma below the surface of the _____
Glossary of geology.fact: intrusionbody of igneous rock that has crystallized from molten magma below the surface of the Earth.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Jurassic A major unit of the geologic timescale that extended from about 199.6 ± 0.6 Ma (million years ago) to 145.4 ± 4.0 Ma, between the end of the _____ and the beginning of the Cretaceous
Glossary of geology.fact: Jurassic A major unit of the geologic timescale that extended from about 199.6 ± 0.6 Ma (million years ago) to 145.4 ± 4.0 Ma, between the end of the Triassic and the beginning of the Cretaceous.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: large igneous province _____ volcanic formation resulting from flood basalt eruptions
Glossary of geology.fact: large igneous province Massive volcanic formation resulting from flood basalt eruptions.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: lava _____ rock expelled by a volcano during an eruption
Glossary of geology.fact: lava Molten rock expelled by a volcano during an eruption.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: liquefaction _____ liquefaction describes the behavior of soils that, when loaded, suddenly suffer a transition from a solid state to a liquefied state, or having the consistency of a heavy liquid
Glossary of geology.fact: liquefaction Soil liquefaction describes the behavior of soils that, when loaded, suddenly suffer a transition from a solid state to a liquefied state, or having the consistency of a heavy liquid.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: lithotype _____ types of rock classified according to the standards of lithology
Glossary of geology.fact: lithotype Specific types of rock classified according to the standards of lithology.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: A mnemonic term for the ferromagnesian and other non-felsic minerals actually present in an igneous rock rich in dark (ferromagnesian) minerals (greater than _____ by volume)
Glossary of geology.fact: A mnemonic term for the ferromagnesian and other non-felsic minerals actually present in an igneous rock rich in dark (ferromagnesian) minerals (greater than 60% by volume).

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: magma _____ rock that sometimes forms beneath the surface of the Earth (or other terrestrial planets) and often collects in a magma chamber
Glossary of geology.fact: magma Molten rock that sometimes forms beneath the surface of the Earth (or other terrestrial planets) and often collects in a magma chamber.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: mantle The highly viscous layer of molten rock situated directly beneath the _____'s crust and above the outer core
Glossary of geology.fact: mantle The highly viscous layer of molten rock situated directly beneath the Earth's crust and above the outer core.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: mesocratic A term applied to igneous rocks which in respect of their content of dark silicates are intermediate between those of leucocratic and melanocratic type, and contain 30–_____ of dark heavy m
Glossary of geology.fact: mesocratic A term applied to igneous rocks which in respect of their content of dark silicates are intermediate between those of leucocratic and melanocratic type, and contain 30–60% of dark heavy minerals.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Mesozoic The era of geological time including the _____, Jurassic, and Cretaceous ages
Glossary of geology.fact: Mesozoic The era of geological time including the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous ages.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: montmorillonite _____ clay mineral with a three layer 2:1 (TOT) structure whose interlayers are mainly occupied by hydrated Na+ and Ca2+ cations and water molecules
Glossary of geology.fact: montmorillonite Swelling clay mineral with a three layer 2:1 (TOT) structure whose interlayers are mainly occupied by hydrated Na+ and Ca2+ cations and water molecules.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The name comes from _____, France
Glossary of geology.fact: montmorillonite Swelling clay mineral with a three layer 2:1 (TOT) structure whose interlayers are mainly occupied by hydrated Na+ and Ca2+ cations and water molecules. The name comes from Montmorillon, France.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Montmorillonite and smectite are two interchangeable synonyms, the first being preferentially used in the US while the second one is more frequent in the literature from UK and _____
Glossary of geology.fact: Montmorillonite and smectite are two interchangeable synonyms, the first being preferentially used in the US while the second one is more frequent in the literature from UK and Europe.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: monoclinic _____ three crystal axes of unequal lengths, with one intersection oblique and the other two perpendicular
Glossary of geology.fact: monoclinic Having three crystal axes of unequal lengths, with one intersection oblique and the other two perpendicular.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Neogene A geologic period starting _____ years ago and, depending on definition, either lasting until today or ending 2.6 million years ago with the beginning of the Quaternary
Glossary of geology.fact: Neogene A geologic period starting 23 million years ago and, depending on definition, either lasting until today or ending 2.6 million years ago with the beginning of the Quaternary.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: non-clastic _____ the properties of any chemically and/or organically deposited rock, such as limestones, chalks, and evaporite deposits
Glossary of geology.fact: non-clastic Having the properties of any chemically and/or organically deposited rock, such as limestones, chalks, and evaporite deposits.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Ordovician A geologic period and system, the second of six of the Paleozoic Era, spanning the time between 485.4 ± 1.9 to 443.4 ± _____ years ago
Glossary of geology.fact: Ordovician A geologic period and system, the second of six of the Paleozoic Era, spanning the time between 485.4 ± 1.9 to 443.4 ± 1.5 million years ago.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It follows the _____ and is followed by the Silurian
Glossary of geology.fact: It follows the Cambrian and is followed by the Silurian.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: orogeny Any set of forces and events leading to a large structural deformation of the _____'s lithosphere due to the engagement of tectonic plates
Glossary of geology.fact: orogeny Any set of forces and events leading to a large structural deformation of the Earth's lithosphere due to the engagement of tectonic plates.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: orthorhombic _____ a crystal structure with three perpendicular axes all of different lengths
Glossary of geology.fact: orthorhombic Having a crystal structure with three perpendicular axes all of different lengths.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The earliest of the three geologic eras of the Phanerozoic Eon, spanning the time from roughly 541 to _____ years ago
Glossary of geology.fact: The earliest of the three geologic eras of the Phanerozoic Eon, spanning the time from roughly 541 to 252.2 million years ago.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It is the longest of the _____ eras and is subdivided into six geologic periods: the Cambrian, Ordovician, Silurian, Devonian, Carboniferous, and Permian
Glossary of geology.fact: The earliest of the three geologic eras of the Phanerozoic Eon, spanning the time from roughly 541 to 252.2 million years ago. It is the longest of the Phanerozoic eras and is subdivided into six geologic periods: the Cambrian, Ordovician, Silurian, Devonian, Carboniferous, and Permian.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The Paleozoic Era follows the _____ of the Proterozoic Eon, and is followed by the Mesozoic Era
Glossary of geology.fact: The Paleozoic Era follows the Neoproterozoic Era of the Proterozoic Eon, and is followed by the Mesozoic Era.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The Pleistocene is the first epoch of the _____ and the sixth epoch of the Cenozoic Era
Glossary of geology.fact: The Pleistocene is the first epoch of the Quaternary Period and the sixth epoch of the Cenozoic Era.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Pliocene The geologic period that extends from _____ to 2.588  million years Before Present
Glossary of geology.fact: Pliocene The geologic period that extends from 5.332 million to 2.588  million years Before Present.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It is the second-youngest epoch of the _____ in the Cenozoic Era
Glossary of geology.fact: It is the second-youngest epoch of the Neogene Period in the Cenozoic Era.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: The Pliocene follows the _____ and is followed by the Pleistocene
Glossary of geology.fact: The Pliocene follows the Miocene and is followed by the Pleistocene.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: pluton plutonic _____ crystallised at depth within the Earth's crust, used of a rock
Glossary of geology.fact: pluton plutonic Having crystallised at depth within the Earth's crust, used of a rock.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: polymictic polysynthetic twinning pore water _____ present in rock and soil pore spaces
Glossary of geology.fact: polymictic polysynthetic twinning pore water Water present in rock and soil pore spaces. Also called interstitial water.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Precambrian A non-standard geologic time period immediately preceding the _____, divided into several eons of the geologic time scale
Glossary of geology.fact: Precambrian A non-standard geologic time period immediately preceding the Phanerozoic Eon, divided into several eons of the geologic time scale.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It spans from the formation of Earth about _____ Ma (million years ago) to the beginning of the Cambrian Period, about 541.0 ± 1.0 Ma, when macroscopic hard-shelled animals first appeared in abundance
Glossary of geology.fact: It spans from the formation of Earth about 4540 Ma (million years ago) to the beginning of the Cambrian Period, about 541.0 ± 1.0 Ma, when macroscopic hard-shelled animals first appeared in abundance.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: pressure solution _____ deformation mechanism involving minerals dissolution under mechanical stress
Glossary of geology.fact: precipitate A rock or mineral precipitated into solid form from an aqueous solution. pressure solution Rock deformation mechanism involving minerals dissolution under mechanical stress.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: prograde metamorphism _____ changes in rocks under increasing pressure and/or temperature conditions
Glossary of geology.fact: precipitate A rock or mineral precipitated into solid form from an aqueous solution. pressure solution Rock deformation mechanism involving minerals dissolution under mechanical stress.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Quaternary The most recent of the three periods of the _____ in the standard geologic time scale
Glossary of geology.fact: Quaternary The most recent of the three periods of the Cenozoic Era in the standard geologic time scale.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It follows the Neogene Period, spanning 2.588 ± _____ years ago to the present
Glossary of geology.fact: It follows the Neogene Period, spanning 2.588 ± 0.005 million years ago to the present.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: "Hügelland" rudaceous _____ the composition and characteristics of clastic rocks, i.e
Glossary of geology.fact: "Hügelland" rudaceous Having the composition and characteristics of clastic rocks, i.e.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: shield A large area of exposed _____ crystalline igneous and high-grade metamorphic rocks that form tectonically stable areas
Glossary of geology.fact: shield A large area of exposed Precambrian crystalline igneous and high-grade metamorphic rocks that form tectonically stable areas.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: silt _____ material of a size somewhere between sand and clay whose mineral origin is quartz and feldspar
Glossary of geology.fact: silt Granular material of a size somewhere between sand and clay whose mineral origin is quartz and feldspar.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: siltstone _____ silt whose granulometry is somewhere between that of sand and clay
Glossary of geology.fact: siltstone Indurated silt whose granulometry is somewhere between that of sand and clay.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: snowball Earth Series of global glaciations in the Precambrian, 600 to _____ years ago, before the hard-shelled animal life explosion
Glossary of geology.fact: snowball Earth Series of global glaciations in the Precambrian, 600 to 700 million years ago, before the hard-shelled animal life explosion.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: sphene _____ deprecated name for a calcium titanium nesosilicate mineral, CaTiSiO5
Glossary of geology.fact: sphene Ancient deprecated name for a calcium titanium nesosilicate mineral, CaTiSiO5.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Since _____, officially called titanite by the International Mineralogical Association
Glossary of geology.fact: Since 1982, officially called titanite by the International Mineralogical Association.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: tectonic plate tektite _____ glass formed from terrestrial ejecta during a meteorite impact
Glossary of geology.fact: tectonic plate tektite Natural glass formed from terrestrial ejecta during a meteorite impact.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: tempestite _____ deposits found in sedimentary formations where shell debris accumulate under the effect of waves and seawater movement
Glossary of geology.fact: tempestite Storm deposits found in sedimentary formations where shell debris accumulate under the effect of waves and seawater movement.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: tephra _____ material produced by a volcanic eruption regardless of composition, fragment size or emplacement mechanism
Glossary of geology.fact: tephra Fragmental material produced by a volcanic eruption regardless of composition, fragment size or emplacement mechanism.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Tethys Ocean A prehistoric ocean that existed between the continents of _____ and Laurasia during the Mesozoic era before the opening of the Indian Ocean
Glossary of geology.fact: Tethys Ocean A prehistoric ocean that existed between the continents of Gondwana and Laurasia during the Mesozoic era before the opening of the Indian Ocean.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: tundra A vast, flat, treeless Arctic region of Europe, Asia, and _____ in which the subsoil is permanently frozen
Glossary of geology.fact: tundra A vast, flat, treeless Arctic region of Europe, Asia, and North America in which the subsoil is permanently frozen.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: undulating hills see "rolling hills" _____ A shallow-water carbonate facies deposited along the northern margins of the Tethys Ocean during the Barremian and Aptian
Glossary of geology.fact: undulating hills see "rolling hills" Urgonian A shallow-water carbonate facies deposited along the northern margins of the Tethys Ocean during the Barremian and Aptian.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Vacuoles are randomly distributed in contrast to the oriented bubble trains of _____
Glossary of geology.fact: Vacuoles are randomly distributed in contrast to the oriented bubble trains of Boehm Lamellae.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: Variscan orogeny Also called the _____ orogeny
Glossary of geology.fact: Variscan orogeny Also called the Hercynian orogeny.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: A geologic mountain-building event caused by _____ continental collision between Euramerica (Laurussia) and Gondwana to form the supercontinent of Pangaea
Glossary of geology.fact: A geologic mountain-building event caused by Late Paleozoic continental collision between Euramerica (Laurussia) and Gondwana to form the supercontinent of Pangaea.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: volcanic _____ that have crystallised from magma poured out at the surface or introduced at shallow depth
Glossary of geology.fact: volcanic Rocks that have crystallised from magma poured out at the surface or introduced at shallow depth.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: volcanic bomb _____ or spindle-shaped rock of mainly basaltic composition ejected during eruptions
Glossary of geology.fact: volcanic bomb Rounded or spindle-shaped rock of mainly basaltic composition ejected during eruptions.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of geology.question: It is defined as the ratio of the uniaxial stress over the uniaxial strain in the range of stress in which _____'s law holds
Glossary of geology.fact: It is defined as the ratio of the uniaxial stress over the uniaxial strain in the range of stress in which Hooke's law holds.

Glossary of geology.subject: Health & Medicine
